query:
SELECT 
  DATE(createdAt) as date,
  userId,
  fingerprint,
  COUNT(*) as usage_count
FROM content_generations
WHERE DATE(createdAt) = CURDATE()
GROUP BY DATE(createdAt), userId, fingerprint
ORDER BY usage_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
